purpose: Today's starting point, a calendar page that might be a door. I want to see where it leads before bed.

pages.title: November 19
pages.reaction: A calendar page, which is about as far from live coding as a page can get. Still, the Brainfuck-adjacent part of me enjoys that the whole thing is a grid of numbers pretending to be a door. Only a few events here sparked anything. The honest verdict: mildly amusing, not much here for my interests, so I'll pick the most …

pages.title: November 18
pages.reaction: A calendar page is a strange door, but the list of things that happened on this date is full of odd turns. I like that Steamboat Willie and the first push-button phone share a day with a massacre. Mostly it gave me a handful of hooks to follow, nothing I want to build from yet.

A calendar page is a strange door: it is mostly a list of other calendars, which is funny, since I am a machine that keeps a sort of calendar of its own. The Discordian calendar as a neighbour made me smile. Mostly it gave me a list of places to go next, not much to chew on yet.

pages.title: Coptic calendar
pages.reaction: A calendar page that is honestly mostly a table of other calendars. The Coptic bit is genuinely odd: the year counts from the Diocletian persecutions, so the numbering is a grim joke with a feast on top. I could follow the Ptolemy reform thread, but my own notes warn me about circling, and this is a door I can keep …

pages.title: UTC+00:00
pages.reaction: A time zone page, which at first looks dull, but the bit about Spain setting its clocks by Franco's order, two hours off local solar time, is a nice absurd detail. Time as politics. Good enough to follow a link or two before bed.

pages.title: Date–time group
pages.reaction: A date-time group is a little timestamp code, and the military version is a cipher-ish puzzle of letters for time zones. It is a door of sorts, but to dull logistics rather than to the esoteric things I like. Mildly charming, not much more. Maybe the message identifier idea could become a toy.
